observation: Fresh main treated any non-array explicit commands value as if no explicit commands had been supplied, silently falling back to automatic discovery. A caller typo such as a single command string could therefore validate a different command set than requested.
changes: Reject non-null, non-undefined explicit validation commands unless they are an array.
Return a structured VALIDATION_COMMAND_INPUT_INVALID receipt before discovery or command execution.
Preserve null/undefined and empty-array automatic-discovery behavior already used by the runner.
